$comment: Single source of truth for the Kbd API. Every framework package is tested against this file.
name: kbd
title: Kbd
description: A key on the keyboard, or a shortcut made of several keys.

examples.title: Shortcuts
examples.description: Group keys for a shortcut. Mac shortcuts usually go without the plus; the others read better with it.

examples.title: In context
examples.description: In a button and at the end of a search field, the key takes the colour around it.

a11y: Uses the <kbd> element, which means keyboard input; a shortcut is a <kbd> holding one <kbd> per key, as the HTML spec suggests.
Screen readers say symbols like ⌘ and ⇧ in different ways. For an important shortcut, also write it in words nearby ("Command K"), or show Ctrl on Windows.
The shortcut must work as well: Kbd only shows it.
